title: Idempotent VM resource cleanup and orphan reconciliation
commit_message: feat(isolation): add idempotent cleanup and reconciliation

deliverables.resource_record: ResourceRecord{vm_id,tenant_id,cgroup_path,netns_name,tap_name,nft_table,socket_paths,chroot_path,pid}; serializable ownership tracking per VM; default_netns_name/default_nft_table helpers; set_pid for post-spawn update
deliverables.cleanup_manager: CleanupManager{cgroup_root,chroot_root,socket_root}; reverse-order cleanup (process->socket->nft->tap->netns->cgroup->chroot); idempotent (repeated cleanup is no-op); best-effort (failures emit LeakRecord, remaining steps continue); configurable filesystem roots for deterministic testing
deliverables.cleanup_backend_trait: CleanupBackend trait abstracts privileged operations (kill_process, flush_nft_table, delete_tap, remove_netns); RealCleanupBackend for production; RecordingCleanupBackend for deterministic tests with configurable failures
deliverables.orphan_reconciler: OrphanReconciler{cgroup_root,netns_root,chroot_root,socket_root,quarantine_dir}; scans for orphaned cgroup leaves, netns, chroots, sockets; quarantines orphans (rename to quarantine dir); cross-tenant protection (never removes resources owned by another tenant); only considers microvm-prefixed netns
deliverables.leak_record: LeakRecord{vm_id,tenant_id,kind,detail,error}; emitted when cleanup cannot complete; serializable; Display impl for operator visibility
deliverables.cleanup_outcome: CleanupOutcome{actions,leaks}; ordered action log with removed flag; is_clean() predicate
deliverables.cleanup_resource_kind: CleanupResourceKind enum (Process,Socket,NftTable,TapDevice,Netns,CgroupLeaf,Chroot) with cleanup_order() returning reverse-creation order

test_coverage.cleanup_ordering: cleanup_follows_reverse_order: verifies process->socket->nft->tap->netns->cgroup->chroot order; cleanup_backend_operations_ordered: verifies backend calls in correct sequence
test_coverage.idempotency: cleanup_is_idempotent: first cleanup removes, second/third are no-ops (all removed=false); cleanup_missing_filesystem_resources_is_noop: absent resources yield removed=false without error
test_coverage.cross_tenant_protection: reconciler_cross_tenant_protection: tenant-a reconciliation never touches tenant-b resources; resources remain on disk
test_coverage.orphan_detection: reconciler_detects_orphan_cgroup/netns/chroot/socket: each resource type detected and quarantined; reconciler_skips_known_resources: tracked resources not flagged; reconciler_mixed_orphans_and_known: mixed scenario correct
test_coverage.leak_records: cleanup_emits_leak_on_process_kill_failure/nft_failure: LeakRecord emitted with correct kind/vm/tenant/error; cleanup_multiple_failures_emit_multiple_leaks: independent failures produce independent leaks; cleanup continues despite failures
test_coverage.lifecycle: end_to_end_cleanup_lifecycle: provision 3 VMs across 2 tenants, cleanup one, reconcile orphans, verify cross-tenant protection, verify idempotent re-cleanup
test_coverage.edge_cases: cleanup_no_pid_skips_process_step: no PID means no kill call; reconciler_empty_dirs_no_orphans; reconciler_missing_dirs_no_orphans; non-microvm netns ignored

guardrails.no_orphan_vmm_processes: cleanup kills VMM process first (reverse order step 1); reconciler detects orphan resources
guardrails.no_cross_tenant_deletion: OrphanReconciler checks tenant ownership before quarantine; cross-tenant resources reported but never touched
guardrails.leak_record_on_failure: every failed cleanup step emits a LeakRecord; failures never silently dropped
guardrails.idempotent_cleanup: repeated cleanup is a no-op (removed=false for all steps)

design_notes.determinism: ResourceRecord construction, CleanupManager ordering, and OrphanReconciler scan logic are pure; filesystem ops use configurable roots tested against tempdir; privileged ops (kill, nft, tap) abstracted behind CleanupBackend trait
design_notes.reverse_order: process->socket->nft->tap->netns->cgroup->chroot mirrors reverse of creation order; ensures dependent resources are removed before their prerequisites
design_notes.quarantine_not_delete: orphan reconciler moves resources to quarantine dir rather than deleting, enabling operator inspection
design_notes.best_effort_cleanup: failed steps do not abort remaining cleanup; all failures captured in LeakRecord list
